title: Celle e righe in openpyxl
code:
from openpyxl import Workbook
ws = Workbook().active
ws.append(["a", "b"])
ws.append([1, 2])
print(ws["B2"].value, ws.max_row)
codeHtml: from openpyxl import Workbook ws = Workbook().active ws.append(["a", "b"]) ws.append([1, 2]) print(ws["B2"].value, ws.max_row)
explain: La seconda riga aggiunta è la riga 2: in B2 c'è 2 e il foglio ha 2 righe.
